description: Header file defining interfaces and data structures for nl80211 socket management in a wireless driver context, including counters, driver IDs, and function prototypes.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_newState
methods.description: Creates a new nl80211 socket context and adds it to the event loop.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getSharedState
methods.description: Returns a shared nl80211 socket manager, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_cleanup
methods.description: Clears and frees a specific nl80211 socket manager context.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_cleanupAll
methods.description: Clears and frees all nl80211 socket managers.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getStateCounters
methods.description: Retrieves statistics counters for a specific nl80211 socket manager.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getAllCounters
methods.description: Retrieves global statistics counters across all nl80211 managers.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getDriverIds
methods.description: Provides nl80211 driver IDs learned at runtime from the kernel.
